# Data Integrity & Tree State Checklist: Add Child Node to a Node in NodeList

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, clarity, and completeness for tree state management, bidirectional references, and Freeplane persistence
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Tree Hierarchy & Bidirectional References

- [x] CHK001 Are bidirectional relationship requirements (`parentNode` and `childNodes`) explicitly defined for all node addition scenarios? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification define how `modificationDate` timestamps must be updated across modified parent and ancestor nodes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Are ancestor propagation requirements specified all the way up to `rootNode` when a node is added deep in the hierarchy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are parent-child reference requirements consistent between the functional specification and data model entities? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §1]

## In-Memory Indexes & State Flow

- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for synchronizing fast-lookup indexes (`nodesByIdIndex`, `nodesByNumericIndex`) upon child creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK006 Does the specification define object equality requirements to guarantee UI state emission when a child's subchild collection changes? [Clarity, Plan §Constraints, Gap]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements specified for numeric ID generation and uniqueness guarantees when creating new nodes? [Edge Case, Data Model §1]

## Persistence & Freeplane XML Compatibility

- [x] CHK008 Are Freeplane XML serialization round-trip fidelity requirements quantified with measurable verification criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Constitution §IV]
- [x] CHK009 Does the specification define how unsaved changes are tracked and flagged across the mindmap document lifecycle? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements specified for preserving arrow links and cross-references when a target node receives new children? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Mutation Boundaries & Edge Conditions

- [x] CHK011 Are boundary requirements defined for appending children to nodes that already contain existing children without altering order? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements specified for tree state preservation when child creation input is canceled or rejected? [Exception Flow, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK013 Is the immutability boundary between ViewModel UI state and NodeManager domain state explicitly defined in requirements? [Consistency, Plan §Constraints]
